clocks.playback_tick: the product's g_playback.tick; demo packet-frame axis, 0..packet_frames
clocks.demo_packet_tick: cmdinfo tick of a demo packet; starts at first_packet_tick and advances with packets
clocks.server_tick: tick carried by net_Tick (type 3); entity history snapshots are keyed by THIS tick
clocks.correct_keying: server_tick = playback_tick + packet_to_server_offset (offset measured on the packet stream; see packet_clock.py)
clocks.known_mismatch: for every demo here the current build is behind by (packet_to_server_offset - first_packet_tick) ticks
